en: Hold it! Don't take another step out there!
text: Stai! Nu mai face niciun pas acolo!

en: Phew, I caught you in time! Wild Pokémon hide in that grass, and they don't take kindly to visitors.
text: Uf, te-am prins la timp! În iarba aia se ascund Pokémoni sălbatici, și nu le plac musafirii.

en: Without a Pokémon of your own to keep you safe, you'd be in real danger. Come along to my lab. Hurry, now!
text: Fără un Pokémon al tău care să te apere, ai fi în mare pericol. Vino cu mine la laborator. Repede!

en: A crackle of lightning raced down the road and was gone over the hills!
A blast of hot wind tore down the road and was gone over the hills!
A cool, clear wind swept down the road and was gone over the hills!
